functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_commusoft_verification_binding(c provider_connections)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('connection_id',c.id,'revision',c.updated_at,'region',c.non_secret_config->>'region',
 'account_key',c.non_secret_config->>'account_key','secret_id',c.secret_refs->>'api_key');
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.provider_secret_name(p_tenant uuid, p_provider text, p_field text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select 'provider_secret:' || p_tenant::text || ':' || lower(p_provider) || ':' || lower(p_field);
$function$
